frozen_target.question: On the exact unresolved Round-195 physical P2 packet region, does the determinant on-shell congruence merge parity and the inverse-residue anchor into a primitive common x-carrier whose genuine step-two difference cancels the conductor singularity before positive norms, or does the literal commutator retain the complete unresolved capacity and yield a rigorous route-scoped self-return?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Keep kappa < D_L and min(Y,D_L) > Q times mfrak times kappa, Q=H_B. In both orientations x=kappa U+2S equals d'/g in the plus chart and d/g in the minus chart. On shell, (-1)^S e(epsilon_omega a inverse_v_q h/q)=chi_4(kappa U) chi_4(x)e(a inverse_2_q x/q). Its step x to x+2 multiplier is z=-e(a/q), while c_q(a)=2/[q(1+e(-a/q))] obeys (1-z)c_q(a)=2e(a/q)/q. Reconstruct the literal operator and prove the full fixed-packet bound |R_core,fix^sigma(P2 W)| << Q times mfrak times kappa times u times X^epsilon, a target-safe strict sector with exact complement, or the first exact self-return.
quantities: The inherited positive estimate is u times {kappa+min(Y,D_L)} times X^epsilon, while the target is Q times mfrak times kappa times u times X^epsilon; the unresolved multiplier min(Y,D_L)/(Q times mfrak times kappa) is strictly larger than one.
The physical P2 mask is imposed before Fourier expansion and height differencing; T=0 and every simultaneous strict T>=1 Farey condition remain.

Both primitive orientations, both frequency signs, the complete anchor aggregate, actual endpoint products, residual selectors, squarefree/coprimality masks, unequal translations, carries, Fejer weights, square-root phases, cells, crossings, births/deaths, physical-mask commutators, conjugations, and zero extensions remain under one outer real part.
The identity (1-z)c_q(a)=2e(a/q)/q may be used only on an actual step-two difference B(x)-B(x-2) arising from the literal recombined event sequence.

Every remainder created by shifting x by two must be priced: endpoints, physical-mask changes, divisibility support, squarefree/coprimality flips, carries, affine births/deaths, phase and Fejer variation, and zero extension.

Primitive carrier completion alone, consecutive-support replacement, arbitrary bounded-array replacement, separate-orientation norms, deleted T branches, or a proper unpriced submask do not prove the target.

Even full success leaves P1, all other original-t incidences, the hard-M1 owner until all complements close, smooth M1, GAR, every M2 parent, endpoint uniformity, M9, both bridges, the quarter theorem, and all exponents separate.
